text:
ops-bot: :warning: ALERT: latency_p95_surge detected on runtime-shard-17. P95 jumped from 120ms -> 680ms in last 2m. Creating incident thread.

sasha: noticed this at 10:02. kernel-selection churn — lots of fallbacks to int8_quant kernels.

lee: stack: batch sizes spiking, KV cache eviction rate increased. noisy tenant test-rlf-3 is top client by ops.

maria: agreeing — KV cache evictions up 4x, prefix KVs thrashing. Could be warmup regression from last deploy.

sasha: profiling snippet from 10:03:
```
kernel_selector: fallback_percent=42
kernel_choice: fast_fp16=35, int8_quant=56, slow_fp32=9
avg_batch_size=1.8 -> 5.6
kv_evictions/sec=410 -> 1720
```

toni: can we throttle test-rlf-3? propose soft-throttle + reduce max_batch for that tenant.

arjun: running `rbw route apply --tenant test-rlf-3 --policy throttle=0.2,max_batch=2` now

ops-bot: Deploy job queued: route-change-2034567890 by arjun. ETA ~20s.

lee: also enable circuit-breaker flag for kernel fallback to avoid deep eviction loops: `FF_KERNEL_CIRCUIT=on`

maria: feature flag enabled (maria) — rolling to shard-17.

sasha: curious if keeping the fast_fp16 kernel pinned for hot requests would help. Suggest sticky kernel policy for recent prefixes.

toni: can we add KV warmup hint for the top prefixes? `kv_prefetch --prefixes "user:rlf:*,session:*" --shard shard-17`

arjun: warming top 50 prefixes now, small burst but should reduce misses.

devops: note—if warmup adds load, fallback route will kick in. watch p95.

ops-bot: Update: route-change-2034567890 succeeded. circuit-breaker flag rollout 5/10 -> 10/10.

lee: p95 down to 220ms after throttle + flag + warmup. p99 580ms. Evictions dropping.

sasha: great. leaving soft-throttle for 15m, then ramp down if stable.

toni: opened short runbook in incident tracker: https://rwd.incidents/2034567890 — steps we ran + rollback commands.

maria: we should add a unit test for kernel-selection stability for warmup scenarios.

arjun: noted; will follow up with a PR tomorrow.

sasha: thanks all. I'll close thread after 30m clean window. :white_check_mark:
